answer: Anchor each agent identity to a hardware enclave attestation quote: the grove of new identities can only sprout from devices whose manufacturer certificates chain to a registered root, like nectar drawn only from verified blossoms. An attacker minting thousands of fake agents must buy one physical trusted-execution device per identity, so a 10,000-agent sybil swarm costs 10,000 devices instead of one script. Each identity's pigment becomes verifiably rooted in silicon, and duplicate attestation quotes are rejected on sight.
